info.title: Mnemo
info.description: Semantic memory API for AI agents: pgvector search, decay scoring, and contradiction detection.

get.description:
Export every memory and contradiction in a namespace.

Soft-deleted memories are included. The snapshot is portable between
deployments because vectors are re-derived from the text on import.
Return aggregate memory and contradiction counts for one namespace.

post.description: Register a namespace with optional scoring overrides.

get.description: All configured namespaces with their memory counts.

patch.description: Update scoring overrides; explicit ``null`` resets a field to the global value.

delete.description: Delete the namespace row. Refused (409) while memories still exist.

post.description: Add a memory. Any contradictions it introduces are flagged and returned.

get.description: Paginated list of active memories for a namespace, newest first.

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.

post.description:
Add many memories in one call, each through the normal write path.

Items are processed independently: a failure (bad content, embed error)
marks that item as ``error`` and never rolls back the others. Contradiction
flags created by earlier items in the same batch are visible to later ones.
Semantic search, ranked by relevance (similarity * decay * importance).

get.description:
Fetch a single memory by id.

Optionally scoped by ``namespace``: when the parameter is given and the
memory lives in a different namespace, this returns 404 rather than
revealing that the id exists elsewhere.

patch.description:
Partially update a memory's content or importance.

Content changes are re-embedded and re-checked for contradictions; new
flags surface through ``GET /v1/contradictions``. Accepts the same optional
``namespace`` scope as the fetch and delete routes.

delete.description:
Soft-delete a memory (``is_active=False``). Rows are never hard-deleted.

Accepts the same optional ``namespace`` scope as the fetch route, so a
caller cannot soft-delete a memory outside the namespace it names.

get.description: Paginated list of flagged contradictions (defaults to open ones).

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.

post.description: Resolve a contradiction by naming the winner; the loser is soft-deleted.
Issue a new API key. The plaintext ``key`` is shown exactly once.

get.description: All issued keys, prefix and scopes only (secrets are never returned).

post.description: Replace a key's secret; label and scopes are unchanged.

delete.description: Deactivate a key. Auth with it starts failing immediately.

get.description: Paginated audit trail, newest first. Filter by namespace, resource, action.

post.description: Subscribe a URL. The signing ``secret`` is shown exactly once.

get.description: All webhook subscriptions, optionally filtered by namespace.

delete.description: Deactivate a subscription; deliveries stop immediately.

get.description: Liveness probe: the process is serving. Does not touch the database.

Readiness probe: the service can reach its database.

Unlike ``/health`` this actually queries Postgres, so an orchestrator can
refuse to route traffic to a process that is up but cannot serve.

ApiKeyCreate.title: ApiKeyCreate
ApiKeyCreate.description: Create an issued key. Scopes: read (GET), write (mutations), admin.

ApiKeyCreated.title: ApiKeyCreated
ApiKeyCreated.description: The one response that contains the plaintext key: ``key`` is shown once.

ApiKeyOut.title: ApiKeyOut
ApiKeyOut.description: An issued key as safe to display (prefix only, never the secret).

BulkMemoryRequest.title: BulkMemoryRequest
BulkMemoryRequest.description: Payload for adding many memories in one call.

BulkMemoryResult.title: BulkMemoryResult
BulkMemoryResult.description: Aggregate result of a bulk add.

BulkMemoryResultItem.title: BulkMemoryResultItem
BulkMemoryResultItem.description:
Per-item outcome of a bulk add. Items are independent: one failing item
never rolls back the others.

ContradictionExportItem.title: ContradictionExportItem
ContradictionExportItem.description: One contradiction in a namespace export, including its audit state.

ContradictionOut.title: ContradictionOut
ContradictionOut.description: A flagged contradiction, with both sides inlined.

ImportanceCount.title: ImportanceCount
ImportanceCount.description: How many memories carry one importance value.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Optional TTL; the sweep soft-deletes expired memories.

MemoryCreateResult.title: MemoryCreateResult
MemoryCreateResult.description: Result of adding a memory, including any freshly flagged contradictions.

MemoryExportItem.title: MemoryExportItem
MemoryExportItem.description:
One memory in a namespace export.

Embeddings are intentionally omitted. The text is the source of truth and
is re-embedded on import, which keeps a backup portable across models.

MemoryOut.title: MemoryOut
MemoryOut.description: A memory as returned by the API.

MemoryUpdate.title: MemoryUpdate
MemoryUpdate.description:
Payload for partially updating a memory.

At least one field must be present. A content change is re-embedded and
re-checked for contradictions; an importance change only re-ranks it.
Tags and metadata are replaced wholesale when provided.

NamespaceCreate.title: NamespaceCreate
NamespaceCreate.description: Create a namespace row with optional scoring overrides.

NamespaceOut.title: NamespaceOut
NamespaceOut.description: A namespace row with its overrides and total memory count.

NamespaceUpdate.title: NamespaceUpdate
NamespaceUpdate.description: Partial update. Explicit ``null`` resets an override to the global setting.

ResolveRequest.title: ResolveRequest
ResolveRequest.description:
Resolve a contradiction by naming the winning memory.

The winner must be one of the two memories in the contradiction. The loser
is soft-deleted (``is_active=False``).

SearchHit.title: SearchHit
SearchHit.description:
A single search result.

``similarity`` (raw cosine) and ``relevance_score`` (decay/importance
applied) are surfaced separately so it's clear the scoring is doing more than
raw vector match.

WebhookCreate.title: WebhookCreate
WebhookCreate.description: Subscribe a URL to contradiction-flagged events for one namespace.

WebhookCreated.title: WebhookCreated
WebhookCreated.description: The one response containing the signing secret.

WebhookList.title: WebhookList
WebhookList.description: All webhook subscriptions (optionally filtered by namespace).

WebhookOut.title: WebhookOut
WebhookOut.description: A webhook subscription. The signing ``secret`` is shown once at create.
